name: Clicks Core Web Vitals Optimizer for WooCommerce — Boost LCP, INP, CLS & PageSpeed Score
author: sykologicist

sections.description:
Clicks Core Web Vitals Optimizer for WooCommerce is a 1-click zero-configuration performance plugin built exclusively for WooCommerce stores. It delivers immediate 90+ Mobile & Desktop PageSpeed scores right on installation.

⚡ 1-Click Optimization: Simply install and activate! All optimal performance features (Static Disk Page Cache, Delay JS Execution Engine, WebP Converter, HTML Minification, Database Auto-Cleanup) are enabled by default. No complex setup required.

⚠️ Important Compatibility Note: For maximum performance and to reach 95+ PageSpeed scores, please deactivate or remove any other page caching plugins (such as WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, W3 Total Cache, or SG Optimizer) to prevent cache conflicts.

🌐 100% Google & SEO Friendly: Engineered with Googlebot-aware architecture. Search engine crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot, Lighthouse) and RSS feeds are fully supported. Bypasses cache for logged-in admins, cart, checkout, and account pages so your site stays 100% indexed and fully functional without hurting SEO.

🚀 What Does This Plugin Fix?

Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) — Slow hero images and render-blocking CSS hurt LCP. The plugin injects LCP preload hints, protects top hero images, and converts images to WebP to cut load times down to ~20ms.

Interaction to Next Paint (INP) — Heavy WooCommerce JavaScript on non-shop pages delays user interaction. The smart dequeuer and Seraphinite-style Delay JS engine eliminate Total Blocking Time (TBT).

Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) — Enforcing image dimensions and lazy loading prevents unexpected layout shifts that frustrate shoppers and reduce conversions.

✅ Key Features

Static Disk Page Cache (~20ms TTFB)
Generates optimized static HTML disk cache served instantly on GET visits, completely bypassing PHP and database overhead.

Seraphinite-Style Delay JavaScript Engine (0ms TBT)
Converts non-critical scripts into delayed execution scripts that load on user touch or scroll, achieving 90+ Mobile scores instantly.

Pre-Cache / Warm-Up Engine with Live Progress Bar
1-click warm-up engine that fetches and static-caches all your site pages, products, blog posts, and categories step-by-step with a live progress bar.

WooCommerce Smart Asset Dequeuer
Stops WooCommerce from loading heavy cart scripts and styles on non-shop pages.

Automatic WebP Image Converter
Every new image you upload is instantly converted to WebP via PHP GD or Imagick with a bulk converter for existing media libraries.

100% SEO & Googlebot Friendly
Preserves all canonical tags, Yoast/RankMath schema JSON-LD, meta tags, and open graph tags. Googlebot crawls superfast without indexing issues.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clicks-core-web-vitals-optimizer-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Deactivate any other active caching plugins (such as LiteSpeed Cache or WP Rocket) for best performance results.
  4. Navigate to Clicks CWV in your WordPress admin sidebar to view your cached pages and run the 1-click Cache Warm-Up!
sections.faq:
Is this plugin a 1-click setup?

Yes! All performance features are ON by default upon activation. You don’t need to tweak complex options.

Should I deactivate other caching plugins like LiteSpeed Cache or WP Rocket?

Yes! For best performance and to avoid double-caching conflicts, please deactivate any other caching plugins. Clicks CWV includes its own built-in Static Page Disk Cache and Delay JS Engine.

Is this plugin Google & SEO friendly?

Yes 100%! All meta tags, schema markup, canonical links, and sitemaps remain intact. Googlebot receives instant ~20ms static pages, improving your search rankings and Core Web Vitals assessment.

Will dequeuing WooCommerce scripts break my cart or checkout?

No. Cart, checkout, and account pages are automatically detected and excluded from static caching and script dequeuing. Your cart and checkout will always work 100% correctly.
